scope: Structural validation only; no automatic mathematical or textual judgments.

checks.check: All final deliverables and integration audits exist
Original NOTES_INDEX source prerequisite exists
items: required fields
claims: required fields
problems: required fields
entries: required columns
readings: required columns
links: required columns
project leads: required columns
events: required columns
claim fate audit: required columns
aliases: required columns
items: unique correctly shaped IDs
claims: unique correctly shaped IDs
problems: unique correctly shaped IDs
Aliases have no conflicting targets or cycles
No retired IDs remain as final item, claim or problem IDs
Exactly 389 unique source IDs in original index
Exactly 389 unique verdict rows
Verdict IDs exactly equal NOTES_INDEX IDs
Every verdict points to a canonical item
Item sources partition all 389 indexed entries exactly once
Item provenance agrees with every entry assignment
All claims reference existing canonical items
All problems retain nonempty occurrence lists
All claim statuses use the six manually normalized categories
All claim classes are A–F
All claim confidences are high, medium or low
Bibliography keys are unique
Every bibliography entry has an explicit verification note
Every reference has a recorded URL or DOI
Claim and problem reference keys are existing and canonical
Every alias resolves to a final record or bibliography key
Dossier and directions cite only existing canonical IDs, including ranges
Main record prose has no stale or missing record cross-references
Dossier/direction bibliographic citation keys resolve canonically
All literal source file/line locators exist and lie within bounds
All structured and explicitly indexed certificate IDs exist in saved output
One fate-audit row for every canonical claim
Every fate-audit row has concrete searches, matching provenance and reference keys
Every namespaced search ID resolves to a literal token in its reader log
Every concrete local code/output/supporting-file pointer exists
Every canonical item has at least one scoped check event
Every canonical claim has at least one scoped check event
Every bibliography key has a scoped reference event
Event statement IDs resolve to canonical items, claims or references
Events have date, actor, permitted type and scoped outcome fields
Checked links exclude external-project leads
